sentences.text: Yevgeny Kurochkin discovered the fossil of this dinosaur in 1982.
Cladistic analyses place this species within Ornithuromorpha, a group containing modern birds but excluding Enantiornithes.
The family Ambiortidae is sometimes assigned to this genus, especially when it is viewed as a close relative of the younger Apsaravis.
A 2011 analysis indicates that Apsaravis and Palintropus are very closely related to this species.
This genus lived between 132.6 and 121.4 million years ago.
Scientists have debated the exact position of this species within the Ornithuromorpha group.
Some studies suggest this species is closely related to Ichthyornithes, a group of birds closely related to modern birds.
Most analyses classify this species as either an unresolved member of Ornithurae or a more basal member of Ornithuromorpha.
